projectDescription: A sales and marketing automation platform built for Family Entertainment Centers (FECs) that enables online sales, party booking, loyalty programs, and targeted marketing campaigns through deep integrations with industry-leading POS and card systems.
keyFeatures: Online play card sales and card balance management
Party and event booking with digital waivers
Automated email and SMS marketing campaigns
Unified guest profiles with game play history
Loyalty and rewards programs (birthday credits, VIP, loyalty points)
Custom landing pages and popup conversion tools
Geographical targeting and dynamic website content
Personalized analytics dashboard with campaign and conversion tracking
Integrations with Intercard, Embed, Sacoa, Brunswick (Meriq), Clubspeed, RTS
publicApiSurface: Online card sales (play cards, gift cards)
Party booking management (create, edit, cancel, reschedule)
Analytics dashboard (campaign performance, conversion rates, leads)
Integration connectors (Intercard, Embed, Sacoa, Brunswick, Clubspeed, RTS)
Rewards program configuration (loyalty points, VIP tiers, birthday credits)
